notes.title: Version 1.1.1 Is Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hello Raiders,

What a month it's been! We've been absolutely blown away by the love and support for Arcane Raiders, we are truly grateful for all players!

We've been hard at work fixing bugs and improving the stability of the game. Patch notes are as follows:
[list]
[*] Fixed the bug preventing players from legally completing runs without taking damage
[*] Fixed the character skin unlock system
[*] Fixed the Dark Cow curse
[*] Fixed mouse inputs on various menu screens
[*] Fixed online glitch causing player names to be removed from the UI during runs
[*] General online stability improvements
[/list]
If you find any more glitches and bugs, please let us know on our [url=https://discord.gg/vPHTPZYBmY]Discord server[/url]!

Thank you all for your continued support of Arcane Raiders!
